hypothesis: Wave 4 showed that exact proposition candidates contain substantially better teacher-aligned evidence than Qwen selects. Replacing only the Qwen proposition-selection call with deterministic BM25 scoring over the exact propositions in each retrieved region should recover most of the available proposition ceiling while reducing model calls, allowing the unchanged Qwen normalizer to be evaluated on better inputs.

predeclared_interpretation: If deterministic selected-proposition teacher alignment materially recovers toward the available-proposition ceiling and final normalized agreement also improves, retain deterministic selection and next isolate normalization quality only if the preserved teacher gate still fails.

If deterministic selected-proposition alignment improves but final normalized agreement does not, proposal selection is solved sufficiently for this benchmark and normalization semantics / teacher-granularity mismatch becomes the primary residual.
If deterministic selected-proposition alignment fails to improve over Wave 4 Qwen selection, reject this selector and revisit candidate ranking or a specialized IE component.
Do not change the preserved teacher F1 threshold after seeing the result.
teacher_control_limitation: The legacy normalized teacher subset contains six claims from one paper, and several historical teacher claims combine multiple facts while the local architecture intentionally emits atomic claims. The scorer and threshold remain unchanged for continuity; proposal-stage source alignment remains an explicit diagnostic.
